scenes.tts: You grip a bar and look at it. Your eyes and your hand disagree about its height. Which do you believe?
scenes.visual: Title card: Which Sense Do You Believe? A hand grips a vertical bar while an eye looks at it. Two labels, eye and hand, point to slightly different heights. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: You grip a bar and look at it. Your eyes and your hand disagree about its height. Which do you believe?

scenes.tts: These numbers are made up. Your eyes say fifty millimetres. Your hand says fifty-four.
scenes.caption: These numbers are made up. Your eyes say 50 mm. Your hand says 54 mm.
scenes.visual: A large horizontal millimetre number line, 44 to 60 mm. A gold tick at 50 labelled vision, a blue tick at 54 labelled touch. Corner label: illustrative numbers.
scenes.narration: These numbers are made up. Your eyes say 50 mm. Your hand says 54 mm.

scenes.tts: Each sense is a ruler that wobbles. Here vision wobbles less. Its standard deviation is two millimetres.
scenes.caption: Each sense is a ruler that wobbles. Here vision wobbles less. Its standard deviation is 2 mm.
scenes.visual: Above the number line, a narrow gold bell curve centred on 50 mm. Label: vision, height likelihood for this trial, SD 2 mm.
scenes.narration: Each sense is a ruler that wobbles. Here vision wobbles less. Its standard deviation is 2 mm.

scenes.tts: Touch wobbles more, with a standard deviation of four.
scenes.caption: Touch wobbles more, with a standard deviation of 4 mm.
scenes.visual: A wide blue bell curve centred on 54 mm joins it. Label: touch, height likelihood for this trial, SD 4 mm.
scenes.narration: Touch wobbles more, with a standard deviation of 4 mm.

scenes.tts: Predict. Should one combined answer land halfway, or nearer one sense?
scenes.visual: A dashed marker hovers at 52 mm with a question mark. Text: Predict. Halfway?
scenes.narration: Predict. Should one combined answer land halfway, or nearer one sense?

scenes.tts: It lands much nearer vision, at fifty point eight millimetres.
scenes.caption: It lands much nearer vision, at 50.8 mm.
scenes.visual: The marker slides from 52 to 50.8 mm and turns solid. Label: 50.8 mm.
scenes.narration: It lands much nearer vision, at 50.8 mm.

scenes.tts: Each weight is set by reliability, one over the variance. Vision gets a weight of zero point eight.
scenes.caption: Each weight is set by reliability, one over the variance. Vision gets a weight of 0.8.
scenes.visual: Weight bars: vision 0.8 (tall, gold), touch 0.2 (short, blue). Formula card: w_V = (1/σV²)/(1/σV² + 1/σH²).
scenes.narration: Each weight is set by reliability, one over the variance. Vision gets a weight of 0.8.

scenes.tts: Read it another way. Start at vision, then move a fifth of the way toward touch.
scenes.visual: An arrow starts at 50 and travels one fifth of the gap toward 54, stopping at 50.8. On screen: 50 + 0.2 × (54 − 50) = 50.8 mm.
scenes.narration: Read it another way. Start at vision, then move a fifth of the way toward touch.

scenes.tts: The combined answer is also steadier than either sense alone, if their errors are independent.
scenes.visual: A narrower purple combined curve rises at 50.8 (SD 1.79 mm). Beside it, variance bars: halfway 5 mm², vision alone 4 mm², weighted 3.2 mm². Small text: if the errors are independent.
scenes.narration: The combined answer is also steadier than either sense alone, if their errors are independent.

scenes.tts: Now blur the picture, until vision wobbles twice as much as touch. Predict. Where does the answer go?
scenes.visual: The bar scene blurs. The gold vision curve widens to SD 8 mm, now wider than touch at SD 4 mm. Text: Predict. Where now?
scenes.narration: Now blur the picture, until vision wobbles twice as much as touch. Predict. Where does the answer go?

scenes.tts: The weights swap. The answer moves to fifty-three point two millimetres, much nearer touch.
scenes.caption: The weights swap. The answer moves to 53.2 mm, much nearer touch.
scenes.visual: The weight bars swap: vision 0.2, touch 0.8. The marker slides from 50.8 to 53.2 mm.
scenes.narration: The weights swap. The answer moves to 53.2 mm, much nearer touch.

scenes.tts: Alais and Burr found this reversal for sound and sight. Severe blur let sound capture the perceived location.
scenes.visual: A blurred light blob and a speaker icon. The perceived-location marker jumps to the speaker. Caption: Alais and Burr, 2004.
scenes.narration: Alais and Burr found this reversal for sound and sight. Severe blur let sound capture the perceived location.

scenes.tts: Ernst and Banks tested the rule in four people, judging bar height by sight and by touch.
scenes.visual: Four observer silhouettes at a bar-height rig: sight only, touch only, both, with noise added to the visual panel. Caption: Ernst and Banks, 2002.
scenes.narration: Ernst and Banks tested the rule in four people, judging bar height by sight and by touch.

scenes.tts: Predictions built from each person's single-sense judgements closely resembled the combined ones.
scenes.visual: Predicted and measured points sit close together on a small plot. Label: maximum-likelihood model.
scenes.narration: Predictions built from each person's single-sense judgements closely resembled the combined ones.

scenes.tts: One task, four people, a behavioural fit. It does not show where in the brain.
scenes.visual: Scope card: one task, four people, a behavioural fit; not where in the brain.
scenes.narration: One task, four people, a behavioural fit. It does not show where in the brain.

scenes.tts: Now one more fact. Some of what your senses report is caused by you.
scenes.visual: The bar curves fade to one side. A separate trace appears, labelled input caused by your own movement, as the hand moves.
scenes.narration: Now one more fact. Some of what your senses report is caused by you.

scenes.tts: Here is the one idea. A signal is worth what it tells you about the world.
scenes.visual: Title card, line 1: A signal is worth what it tells you about the world.
scenes.narration: Here is the one idea. A signal is worth what it tells you about the world.

scenes.tts: For one event, the more reliable sense counts for more.
scenes.visual: Line 2 appears: for one event, the more reliable sense counts for more.
scenes.narration: For one event, the more reliable sense counts for more.

scenes.tts: Part of what you sense is the predictable result of your own movement. Some pathways subtract a prediction of it.
scenes.visual: Line 3 appears: some pathways subtract a prediction of what your own movement causes. Small text: the next chapters show where, and when.
scenes.narration: Part of what you sense is the predictable result of your own movement. Some pathways subtract a prediction of it.

scenes.tts: Take this with you. Weigh each sense by its reliability. Then ask which predictable results of your own movement get subtracted.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: weigh each sense by its reliability; ask which predictable results of your movement get subtracted.
scenes.narration: Take this with you. Weigh each sense by its reliability. Then ask which predictable results of your own movement get subtracted.
